title: Scoring server readiness timeout hides the last ping error
answers: scoring server timed out waiting to become ready with no reason
why does the model server readiness check fail with a generic timeout
ScoringServerClient wait_server_ready timeout error missing connection refused details
mlflow serve model not ready after timeout, what was the underlying error
body:
Symptom: A model server (mlflow models serve / pyfunc scoring server) fails to start in CI or locally with only a generic "Wait scoring server ready timeout." message, so users cannot tell whether connections were refused or the server returned an HTTP error.
Root cause: mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server/client.py:ScoringServerClient.wait_server_ready caught every exception from self.ping() with a bare `except Exception: pass` and raised a fixed RuntimeError with no URL, timeout, or cause.
Fix pattern: Keep the last caught exception (`except Exception as error: last_error = error`), build the message from the server URL (self.url_prefix), elapsed time, the configured timeout, and optional scoring_server_proc.pid, append `type(last_error).__name__: last_error`, and `raise RuntimeError(message) from last_error`.
Constraints: Polling interval, timeout value, and the early exit on scoring_server_proc.poll() must stay unchanged; the early-exit RuntimeError is raised without a ping cause. Only the timeout branch is diagnostic.
applies: Applies to readiness/wait helpers in mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server/client.py; any similar wait-for-ready loop that swallows exceptions should follow the same capture-and-chain pattern.
says: Model serving startup fails with a generic timeout message without explaining the underlying error.
Local model server readiness check times out without displaying connection refused details.
Include the actual network response error when model deployment readiness times out.
Automated deployment checks fail on model startup with no diagnostic failure reason given.
search: Model scoring server readiness loops must capture and chain the final ping exception upon timeout. In mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server/client.py:ScoringServerClient.wait_server_ready, preserve the last caught exception from self.ping() and include self.url_prefix, elapsed time, timeout duration, and optional scoring_server_proc.pid in the raised RuntimeError. Polling intervals, timeout thresholds, and the early exit on scoring_server_proc.poll() remain unchanged, with only the timeout branch providing diagnostic chained errors.
